title: QuickStack commandlets: micro-runbooks as safe, composable admin utilities
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Ship a small library and CLI surface that expose curated 'quickstack' commandlets: parameterized, typed micro-runbooks that perform common admin tasks (rotate-keys, drain-node, snapshot-db, remediate-threaddump). Goals: atomicity, dry-run, RBAC enforcement, telemetry tagging, and easy composition in larger runflows. This reduces toil for oncall and provides a trusted building block for automated remediations and runbooks-as-tasks.
comments: 2025-01-29 — Spike: implemented prototype commandlet runner with typed params and dry-run flag. Local tests for 'drain-node' succeeded against staging k8s cluster.
2025-02-03 — Design review (PM + Security): agreed on minimal param surface and mandatory dry-run by default for any stateful action. Security requested KMS-based signing for irreversible ops.
2025-02-07 — Implementing telemetry: added tags for runbook_id, invocation_id, actor, and dry_run. Need to align with ops-telemetry schema.
2025-02-12 — PR opened: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/11234 — awaiting CI and security review for secret handling.
2025-02-18 — Blocker: RBAC client currently lacks attribute-based checks; coordinating with auth infra (ENG-672401) to surface identity attributes for enriched gating.
acceptance_criteria: Commandlet library published to internal PyPI and small Golang shim for CLI invocations
At least 6 curated commandlets implemented with unit tests and end-to-end smoke tests against staging
Dry-run is default; any stateful command requires explicit --confirm flag and audit log entry
RBAC gating enforced: CLI returns 403 if user lacks required roles and logs the attempted action
Telemetry emits runbook_id, invocation_id, actor, result, and latency to ops-telemetry pipeline
Documentation and quickstart guide published in internal Confluence with playbook examples and rollback steps
decisions: Favor typed parameter schema (JSON Schema) for each commandlet to enable validation and generated CLI flags
Default to dry-run=true for safety; require explicit --confirm for mutation
Use existing ops-telemetry instead of a separate telemetry stream to simplify dashboards
Implement a small adapter layer to translate commandlets into existing runbook task graph format for composition
next_steps: Finish RBAC attributes integration with auth infra and re-run security checklist
Add KMS-based signing for confirm flows (POC in next sprint)
Complete 4 remaining curated commandlets (snapshot-db, rotate-keys, uncordon-node, collect-procstate)
Merge PR 11234 after tests and address security items, then publish internal package
Create Console integration ticket to expose quickstack UX and CLI-runbook linking (PM to file)
